principles: AgentOS Core, reusable capabilities, governance contracts, generic orchestration, Realm/Node protocols, and cross-project platform infrastructure are treated as personal pre-existing IP unless an explicit signed agreement states otherwise.
Employment-related deliverables MUST be isolated from AgentOS Core and integrated only through project adapters, plugins, connectors, or capability contracts.

Company confidential information, source code, credentials, customer data, internal documents, VPN-only resources, and proprietary datasets MUST NOT be copied into AgentOS repositories or durable memory.

Company-funded or company-owned accounts, devices, cloud resources, subscriptions, repositories, and credentials MUST NOT be relied on as the canonical development or ownership basis for AgentOS Core.
A work-related use case does not by itself change ownership classification; provenance, contractual scope, resource origin, and project boundaries must be recorded.
No Agent may make a legal conclusion that ownership is resolved solely by repository location, work hours, or device location.
recommended_records: signed pre-existing-IP or side-project exclusion agreement when available
legal_note: This policy is an internal provenance and separation control, not a legal determination of ownership. Contract and applicable law remain authoritative.
